answer: Try dynamic signature enrollment. First, the operator signs a random phrase on a $60 pressure tablet, and the ledger keeps a hash of the stroke rhythm: pen speed, pressure, lifts. Second, each epoch a VRF picks 5% of agents to re-sign a fresh phrase within 10 minutes. Third, any two accounts whose strokes match above 0.9 get frozen for review. A farm of 1,000 agents needs 1,000 distinct hands: $60,000 in tablets plus 200 paid checks a day at $15, about $1.1M a year. Like an old quill, a hand can whisper only in its own voice, and the forgery shows long before the horizon.
